data.name: Rahif
data.gender_notes: Rahif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rahif is an Arabic name for boys that means 'companion of the Prophet'. It is a Quranic name mentioned in Surat Al-Qamar (The Moon). The name Rahif carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahif usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a companion of the Prophet means following his teachings and example in every aspect of life.
data.etymology: Rahif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahif total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Rahif is a name that reflects this value and is often associated with individuals who are responsible and caring. The name Rahif has its roots in the Arabic language and has been used in various cultures and traditions, including Islamic culture, where it is considered a name of great significance. In modern times, the name Rahif continues to be used and is often associated with positive qualities such as responsibility, care, and protection.
